title: Database Creation Config
description: Configuration schema for building a barcoding sequence database.

seq.description: Primer sequence. Must only contain uppercase bases A, T, G, C, and N for degenerate sites.

min_len.description: Minimum length of the primer match required during trimming. Recommended to be at least 2/3 of the actual primer length.

base_dir.description: Output folder in which all database files will be stored. May be an absolute or relative path. Must NOT contain spaces or slashes.

db_name.description: File/directory name of the database. Also used to uniquely identify the final database files. Must NOT contain spaces or slashes.

organism.description: Scientific name of the taxonomic group of interest (as used in the NCBI taxonomy database).

keywords.description: Keywords for the barcoding locus used as a sequence search query. Include all variations and synonyms of the gene name and acronyms.

min_seq_len.description: Minimum sequence length after trimming. Sequences shorter than this value will be discarded. Recommended to cover at least 2/3 of the desired amplicon length (excluding primers).

max_seq_len.description: Maximum sequence length after trimming, excluding primers. Recommended to be at most 50% larger than the desired amplicon length.

find_outgroups.description: Whether to search for amplicons outside of the specified taxon using Primer-BLAST to detect host contaminations.

primer_blast.description: Settings for the Primer-BLAST outgroup search.

enable_cache.description: Whether to cache Primer-BLAST results locally to avoid re-running the search on subsequent workflow runs.

cache_file.description: Path to the SQLite file where Primer-BLAST results are cached.

gappiness_threshold.description: Maximum allowed gappiness score. Sequences above this threshold are removed from the alignment. Value between 0 (no gaps) and 1 (maximum gaps).

max_ambiguous_bases.description: Maximum number of ambiguous bases (anything except A, T, G, C) allowed in a sequence after trimming.

tree.description: Settings for phylogenetic tree inference with IQ-TREE.

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations after which IQ-TREE terminates tree optimization. More iterations yield better trees but take longer.

remove_on_species.description: Whether to remove open nomenclature (ON) species from the database. ON sequences are removed when a sequence with the sanitized name already exists. Disable to study the effect of including ON species.

mislabel_detection.description: Settings for detecting sequences with likely incorrect taxonomic labels using a k-nearest-neighbor majority vote.

k.description: Maximum number of nearest neighbors to consider. If fewer neighbors exist within max_radius, all of them are used.

max_radius.description: Maximum distance within which to look for neighbors.

min_neighbors.description: Minimum number of neighbors within max_radius required to attempt classification. Sequences with fewer neighbors are left unclassified.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum majority-vote score to flag a sequence as mislabeled. Value between 0 and 1.

rank_level.description: Taxonomic rank at which to evaluate labels. Also detects mislabels at higher ranks automatically.
